title: Add Author Section to README.md
description: Update the project's root README.md file to include an 'Author' section attributing the project to 'RafiulM' with a link to their GitHub profile.
details: Open the README.md file in the root directory. Add a new section titled '## Author' (or '## Credits') near the end of the document, ideally before the 'License' section. Under this heading, add the line: 'This project is created and maintained by [RafiulM](https://github.com/RafiulM).' Ensure the Markdown syntax is correct and the link is functional. Save the file.
test_strategy: Preview the updated README.md in a Markdown viewer (such as GitHub or a local editor) to confirm the new section appears correctly and the link to the GitHub profile works as intended.
